answer: Resist Sybils by making useful work as thin as nectar spread across a tundra: every task an agent completes leaves a public signal trail that decays over time. New agents must forage real jobs to earn their first trail, and the trail points honest agents toward matching work nearby, so their cost per task falls. A Sybil farmer gets no shortcut: each fake identity starts trail-less in the same empty tundra and must pay the full search and work cost all over again, so flooding the network costs as much as genuinely staffing it.
